name: SMS Alert Template Suite
description: A comprehensive suite of SMS alert templates used by FirstUK Bank for customer communications. Managed by the Head of Marketing and utilized by Customer Service and Operations staff.
context: FirstUK Bank — SMS Alert Template Suite

name: Large Withdrawal Alert
description: An SMS notification triggered when a withdrawal exceeding £1,000 is made via mobile or ATM. It prompts the customer to verify the transaction or contact the bank immediately for fraud prevention.
context: FirstUK: Large withdrawal of £[amount] from your account [last 4 digits]. If not you, call 0800-555-2265 immediately. Ref: [code]

name: Withdrawal Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the specific monetary value of the large withdrawal that triggered the alert.

name: Account Last Four Digits
description: A dynamic placeholder used to identify the affected account to the customer by displaying only the final four digits for security.

name: Reference Code
description: A unique alphanumeric reference code provided in the alert to help the bank identify the specific transaction during a customer call.

name: Template 2: Transfer Sent Confirmation
description: An SMS notification sent to customers upon the successful completion of a fund transfer. It provides the amount sent, the recipient's name, and the updated account balance.
context: FirstUK: Transfer of £[amount] to [recipient name] completed. Your balance: £[new balance].

name: Transfer Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the specific monetary value of the transfer that has been completed.

name: Recipient Name
description: A dynamic placeholder for the name of the person or entity receiving the funds.

name: New Account Balance
description: A dynamic placeholder showing the customer's remaining account balance after the transfer has been deducted.

name: Transfer Recipient
description: The party receiving the funds as referenced in the Transfer Sent Confirmation template.

name: Transferring Account
description: The customer account from which funds are being transferred and for which a new balance is reported.

name: Successful Transfer
description: A completed financial transfer that serves as the trigger for the confirmation communication.

name: Template 3: Failed Direct Debit Alert
description: An SMS notification triggered when a Direct Debit is rejected due to insufficient funds or other reasons. It informs the customer of the amount, the biller, and the date of failure, urging them to add funds.
context: Trigger: Direct Debit rejected (insufficient funds, etc.)
FirstUK: Direct Debit of £[amount] to [biller] failed on [date]. Reason: [insufficient funds/other]. Add funds to retry.

name: amount
description: The specific monetary value of the Direct Debit payment that failed to process.

name: biller
description: The name of the entity or organization that was intended to receive the Direct Debit payment.

name: date
description: The calendar date on which the Direct Debit rejection occurred.

name: insufficient funds/other
description: The reason provided for the failure of the Direct Debit transaction.

name: Failed Direct Debit
description: A financial event where a scheduled Direct Debit payment is rejected, typically due to a lack of available funds.

name: Direct Debit
description: A banking product/service allowing automated payments from a customer's account to a biller.

name: Template 4: Card Payment Alert
description: An SMS alert triggered when a contactless or online payment exceeds £500. It notifies the customer of the transaction details and provides a fraud line for immediate reporting.
context: FirstUK: Card payment of £[amount] at [merchant] on [date] [time]. If not you, call 0800-555-2265 fraud line immediately.

name: Transaction Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the monetary value of the card payment that triggered the alert.

name: Merchant Name
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the name of the vendor or merchant where the transaction occurred.

name: Transaction Date
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the calendar date the transaction took place.

name: Transaction Time
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the specific time the transaction was processed.

name: Cardholder
description: The bank customer who receives the payment alert and is requested to verify the transaction.
context: If not you, call 0800-555-2265 fraud line immediately.

name: Payment Card
description: The payment instrument used for the contactless or online transaction that triggered the alert.

name: High Value Card Transaction
description: A contactless or online payment exceeding £500 that serves as the trigger for a security notification.

name: Template 5: Suspicious Activity Alert
description: An SMS communication template triggered by a moderate risk fraud detection rule. It notifies the customer of unusual activity and requests immediate confirmation via phone or reply to prevent transaction restrictions.
context: Trigger: Fraud detection rule triggered (moderate risk)
FirstUK: Unusual activity detected on your account. Call 0800-555-2265 to confirm. For security, we may restrict transactions. Reply CONFIRM or call immediately.

name: Customer
description: The recipient of the Suspicious Activity Alert who is being notified of unusual activity on their account.
context: Unusual activity detected on your account

name: Customer Account
description: The bank account associated with the customer that has triggered a fraud detection rule due to unusual activity.
context: Unusual activity detected on your account

name: Unusual Activity Transactions
description: Financial activities that have triggered a moderate risk fraud detection rule, potentially leading to account restrictions.
context: Unusual activity detected on your account

name: Suspicious Activity Alert
description: A security notification sent to customers when fraud detection rules identify moderate risk activity.
context: Trigger: Fraud detection rule triggered (moderate risk)

name: Template 6: Card Lost/Blocked Alert
description: An SMS notification sent to customers when their payment card has been blocked due to suspected fraud or reported loss. It provides instructions for using online banking, visiting a branch, or ordering a replacement card.
context: Trigger: Card blocked due to fraud or loss
FirstUK: Your [product] card has been blocked. Use online banking or visit a branch. Order replacement: Call 0800-555-2265 or online at www.firstuk.bank

name: Product Variable
description: A dynamic placeholder used to specify the type of card (e.g., Debit, Credit) that has been blocked.

name: Payment Card
description: The banking product subject to the blocking action and replacement process described in the communication template.

name: Blocked Card
description: A card that has been rendered inactive due to fraud or loss, triggering a customer alert.
context: Card blocked due to fraud or loss

name: Template 7: Password Reset Initiated
description: An SMS communication sent to a customer when a password reset has been requested. It provides a time-limited link for password creation and instructions to ignore the message if the request was not initiated by the user.
context: FirstUK: Password reset requested. Click link to create new password: [short URL]. Expires in 24h. Ignore if you didn't request this.

name: Password Reset URL
description: A dynamic short URL placeholder embedded in the password reset SMS that directs the customer to the password creation page.
context: Click link to create new password: [short URL].

name: Password Reset Recipient
description: The bank customer who has either requested a password reset or is the target of an unauthorized reset attempt.
context: Ignore if you didn't request this.

name: Template 8: 2FA Code (One-Time)
description: A short-form security notification triggered when Two-Factor Authentication is required. It delivers a time-sensitive security code and provides a contact number for reporting unauthorized requests.
context: FirstUK: Your security code is [6-digit code]. Never share this.

name: 6-digit code
description: A dynamic placeholder for a unique, six-digit one-time password used to verify the user's identity during the 2FA process.

name: 2FA Recipient
description: The bank customer who is the recipient of the security code and is being prompted to authenticate their identity.
context: If you didn't request this, call 0800-555-2265.

name: Unauthorized 2FA Request Alert
description: A security warning within the 2FA communication that instructs the customer to contact the bank if they did not initiate the authentication request, serving as a fraud detection signal.
context: If you didn't request this, call 0800-555-2265.

name: Template 9: Account Opened Confirmation
description: An SMS or short-form notification sent to customers once a new account has been successfully created. It provides the account number and instructions for activation via the bank's login portal.
context: FirstUK: Welcome! Your SmartSaver account is open. Account: [ACC-XXXXX]. Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login to activate.

name: Account Number Placeholder
description: A dynamic placeholder used in the Account Opened Confirmation template to insert the specific account number of the newly created account.

name: SmartSaver account
description: A specific banking product offered by FirstUK that is the subject of the account opening confirmation communication.

name: New Account Customer
description: The recipient of the Account Opened Confirmation template who has just successfully created a new account.

name: New SmartSaver Account
description: The newly created account that triggers the confirmation communication and requires activation.

name: Template 10: Interest Payment Notification
description: An SMS notification sent to customers when monthly interest is credited to their account. It provides the credited amount, the new balance, and the applicable AER rate.
context: FirstUK: Interest of £[amount] credited to your account. New balance: £[balance]. At 4.50% AER.

name: Interest Amount Variable
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the specific amount of interest being credited to the customer's account.
context: Interest of £[amount] credited to your account.

name: Account Balance Variable
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the updated account balance after the interest payment has been applied.

name: Template 11: Standing Order Executed
description: An SMS notification sent to customers when a recurring standing order payment has been successfully processed. It provides the amount, payee, date, and the remaining account balance.
context: Trigger: Recurring standing order payment processed
FirstUK: Standing order of £[amount] to [payee] processed on [date]. Your balance: £[balance].

name: amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the monetary value of the standing order payment that was executed.

name: payee
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the name of the recipient of the standing order payment.

name: date
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the date on which the standing order payment was processed.

name: balance
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the customer's remaining account balance after the standing order has been deducted.

name: Template 12: Account Verification Needed
description: An SMS notification triggered when KYC documents are required from a customer. It instructs the customer to upload ID via a portal or call a specific number to avoid account restriction.
context: FirstUK: We need your ID to complete verification. Upload at www.firstuk.bank/kyc or call 0800-555-2265. Deadline: [date]. Your account will be restricted if not completed.

name: Verification Deadline Date
description: A dynamic date placeholder indicating the final deadline by which the customer must provide their KYC documentation to avoid account restrictions.

name: Customer requiring KYC verification
description: The recipient of the account verification communication who is required to provide identification documents.
context: We need your ID to complete verification

name: Customer Account subject to restriction
description: The bank account associated with the customer that will be restricted if the KYC verification process is not completed by the deadline.
context: Your account will be restricted if not completed.

name: KYC Document Verification Process
description: The process of collecting and verifying customer identification documents via a web portal or phone call.

name: Template 13: Rate Change Alert
description: An SMS notification sent to customers when their interest rate is updated, typically on a monthly basis. It informs the customer of the new rate, the previous rate, and the corresponding Bank of England base rate movement.
context: FirstUK: Your rate changed to [new rate]% AER (was [old rate]%). Bank of England base rate moved to [new BoE rate]%. Your new interest starts next month.

name: New Interest Rate
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the updated interest rate AER to be applied to the customer's account.
context: Your rate changed to [new rate]% AER

name: Old Interest Rate
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the previous interest rate AER before the update occurred.

name: Bank of England Base Rate
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the current Bank of England base rate that triggered or influenced the rate change.
context: Bank of England base rate moved to [new BoE rate]%

name: Template 14: Fraud Claim Resolved
description: An SMS notification sent to customers once a disputed transaction has been investigated and a resolution reached. It informs the customer of the resolution and the refund amount processed.
context: Trigger: Disputed transaction investigated and resolved
FirstUK: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved. Refund of £[amount] processed.

name: Claim Reference Number
description: A dynamic placeholder used to identify the specific dispute claim associated with the customer's fraud case.
context: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved.

name: Refund Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the specific monetary value being refunded to the customer following the resolution of the fraud claim.

name: Fraud Claim Recipient
description: The bank customer who has filed a dispute claim and is receiving notification of the resolution.
context: Your dispute claim (Ref: [EXC-XXXXX]) has been resolved.

name: Disputed Transaction
description: A financial transaction that was flagged as fraudulent or incorrect and underwent an investigation process.
context: Trigger: Disputed transaction investigated and resolved

name: Template 15: Branch Appointment Reminder
description: An SMS reminder sent to customers 24 hours before a scheduled branch meeting to confirm the location and time, providing a contact number for rescheduling.
context: FirstUK: Reminder: You have an appointment at [branch name] on [date] at [time]. Contact 0800-555-2265 if you need to reschedule.

name: branch name
description: A placeholder for the specific FirstUK bank branch where the customer's appointment is scheduled.
context: You have an appointment at [branch name]

name: date
description: A placeholder for the calendar date of the scheduled branch appointment.

name: time
description: A placeholder for the specific time of the scheduled branch appointment.

name: Appointment Customer
description: The recipient of the branch appointment reminder who has a scheduled meeting at a FirstUK branch.
context: You have an appointment at [branch name]

name: Template 16: Account Closure Confirmation
description: A short-form notification sent to customers once an account closure has been processed. It provides the account reference, the final balance amount, the transfer method, and a contact number for queries.
context: FirstUK: Your account has been closed (Ref: [ACC-XXXXX]). Final balance of £[amount] will be transferred to [method] within 3–5 days.

name: Account Reference Number
description: A dynamic placeholder used to identify the specific account that has been closed.

name: Final Balance Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the remaining monetary balance to be transferred to the customer upon closure.

name: Transfer Method
description: A dynamic placeholder specifying the destination or method by which the final balance will be delivered to the customer.

name: Account Holder
description: The recipient of the account closure confirmation who is exiting their relationship with the bank for a specific account.

name: Closed Account
description: The specific bank account that has undergone the closure process as the trigger for the communication.

name: Template 17: Maintenance Notice
description: An SMS template used to notify customers of scheduled system maintenance and the resulting temporary unavailability of online and mobile banking services.
context: FirstUK: Scheduled maintenance 02:00–03:00 AM on [date]. Online/mobile banking temporarily unavailable.

name: Maintenance Date
description: A dynamic date placeholder used in the Maintenance Notice template to specify when the scheduled system maintenance will occur.

name: Template 18: Survey Request (Optional)
description: An optional SMS communication sent to customers following a transaction or a support interaction to gather feedback on their experience via a web link.
context: FirstUK: How did we do? Rate your experience: www.firstuk.bank/survey

name: Bank Customer
description: The recipient of the survey request who has recently completed a transaction or support interaction with FirstUK.

name: Post-transaction Event
description: A financial transaction that serves as a trigger for sending the Survey Request template.

name: Template 19: Unrecognized Login Alert
description: An SMS security notification triggered by a login attempt from a new device or location. It instructs the customer to reset their password or contact the fraud line if the activity was unauthorized.
context: Trigger: Login from new device or location
FirstUK: Login attempt on [date] [time] from [location/device]. If not you, change password immediately

name: Login Date and Time
description: Dynamic placeholders used to specify the exact date and time the unrecognized login attempt occurred.

name: Login Location and Device
description: A dynamic placeholder identifying the geographic location or the specific hardware device used for the login attempt.

name: Customer
description: The recipient of the security alert who is being notified of a potential unauthorized access attempt to their account.
context: If not you, change password immediately

name: Template 20: Payment Reversal Notification
description: An SMS notification sent to customers when a transaction has been reversed or refunded. It provides the amount, recipient, and a reference number for the refund.
context: FirstUK: Transaction of £[amount] to [recipient] has been reversed. Refund credited to your account. Ref: [EXC-XXXXX].

name: amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the monetary value of the transaction being reversed.

name: recipient
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the name of the party to whom the original payment was sent.

name: EXC-XXXXX
description: A dynamic placeholder for the unique transaction or refund reference number.

name: Customer
description: The recipient of the payment reversal notification who holds an account with FirstUK.

name: Customer Account
description: The bank account to which the reversed transaction funds are credited.

name: Reversed Transaction
description: A financial event where a previous payment is reversed or refunded, triggering a customer notification.
context: Transaction of £[amount] to [recipient] has been reversed.

name: SMS Support Contact Requirement
description: A requirement that all SMS communications must provide a phone number for customer support to ensure accessibility and assistance.
context: Always include phone number for support

name: SMS Sensitive Information Prohibition
description: A strict prohibition against requesting or including sensitive customer data such as PINs, passwords, or full account numbers within SMS messages.
context: Never ask for sensitive info via SMS (PIN, full account number)
Do NOT Include in SMS: Full account numbers (use last 4 digits only)
Do NOT Include in SMS: Passwords or PINs

name: SMS Opt-Out Notification Requirement
description: An obligation to inform customers that they have the ability to opt out of non-critical SMS alerts through their online banking settings.
context: All SMS templates should include note that customers can opt out of non-critical alerts via online banking settings.

name: SMS Reference/Confirmation Code
description: A dynamic reference or confirmation code included in SMS templates to allow customers to identify specific transactions or requests.

name: Partial Account Number
description: A truncated version of the customer's account number, limited to the last 4 digits for security purposes in SMS communications.
context: Full account numbers (use last 4 digits only)
